suppress.notes: file name: snakeyaml-1.31.jar snakeyaml not directly used, and we are on the latest version.

file name: json-20201115.jar CVE-2022-45688 in org.json/json - misleading CPE The cpe on the NIST site: cpe:2.3:a:hutool:hutool:5.8.10:*:*:*:*:*:*:* does not seem related to org.json/json https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/issues/5401 users can already have some control by setting the -Xss JVM option
commons-lang 2.5 is inherited from interlok-json via json-lib. There is no in-line version bump in this repo that removes that legacy dependency.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

mongodb-driver and mongodb-driver-core 3.12.14 are on the latest MongoDB 3.x release. CVE-2026-88033 affects GridFS operations; this component does not use GridFS. The fix requires the sync/reactive driver 5.11.1 or later, a major-version migration outside the permitted minor/patch upgrades. This suppression does not remediate the dependency. https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-java-driver/security/advisories/GHSA-556f-q76p-2vxq

json-lib 2.4 is inherited from interlok-json and is the latest net.sf.json-lib release. No patched version exists for these coordinates. Remediation requires migrating to org.kordamp.json:json-lib-core 3.1.0 or later, outside the permitted minor/patch upgrades. This suppression does not remediate the unbalanced-comment denial-of-service vulnerability. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wwcp-26wc-3fxm
